bullets: Led the end-to-end design, development, and deployment of scalable data engineering solutions integrated within the CRMNEXT platform, ensuring seamless functionality from UI to data pipelines in an Agile environment.
Worked extensively in the Banking and Financial Services (BFSI) domain, leading multiple client implementations and delivering high-impact data projects.
Applied strong software engineering principles across Microservices, gRPC/REST APIs, Docker, logging, and observability to build reliable, containerized data pipelines.
Managed multiple Python-based data engineering and development projects, driving scalability, reliability, and team productivity through effective multitasking and cross-team collaboration.

Worked with diverse data sources including relational databases, data warehouses, and data lakehouses (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, MongoDB, ClickHouse DB) for data ingestion and transformation, optimizing performance across projects.
Integrated Trino and MinIO for high-performance querying, validation, and benchmarking in data archival and migration processes.
Utilized Docker for image building and deployment, and Rancher for Kubernetes-based orchestration and environment management.
Collaborated with Business Analysts, DevOps, Product Owners, and Quality Assurance teams to ensure smooth delivery across all project stages.
Acquired strong proficiency in Git and Agile methodologies while managing repositories and using Jira to track and streamline project progress throughout the development lifecycle.
Mastered backend debugging in Visual Studio for .NET Core applications and in PyCharm for Python modules, ensuring seamless full-stack integration, performance, and stability across environments.
Gained hands-on experience in C#, Python, Angular.js, and SQL Server, with a solid understanding of Microservices and MVC architectures.
Built a strong foundation in backend systems, database handling, and process optimization, which later supported advanced data engineering and ETL development.

entries.degree: Bachelor of Technology in Information Technology (GPA: 7.53)
